whatToWatch.text: That defense travels — Seattle allowed just 10 points in the opener and got home for 3 sacks. Arizona's front is doing the same thing (3 sacks, 14 points allowed), so this shapes up as a street fight with a 40.5 total that says points won't come easy.

Seattle's 3.5-point road favorite tag is a statement of trust, but the injury sheet is honest about the challenge: one player out and four questionable, with Anthony Bradford, Nick Emmanwori and Ty Okada among the names to watch on the status report.

Arizona's got nobody ruled out, though Isaiah Adams and Isaac Seumalo are worth tracking up front — if that Cardinals line is short-handed, this is the game where Seattle's pass rush can take over and push the 1-0 start to 2-0.

newsBlurb.text: Drew Lock takes the reins in Arizona with Sam Darnold sidelined, and nobody's sure whether the injury costs Seattle one week or three. Lock looked steady in relief against New England, where the defense flipped last year's Week 1 script and closed out a 13-10 comeback instead of coughing it up late. Now Mike Macdonald's group finds out if that formula travels on the road — and Terrion Arnold's new deal gives the secondary another piece to lean on.
